name: webui_addon
description: Create, update, list, and toggle ad-hoc web UI addons (views under ui/plugins/). Use when the operator asks to add a page, widget, or tool to the web UI (a music player, dashboard, timer, …). create writes plugin.json + app.js (+ optional app.css) and enables the addon. enable/disable flip System → Web UI plugins. The page loads new scripts after Refresh or a reload.
llm_description: Web UI addon CRUD. Actions: list; create {name,title?,description?,group=Work|Watch|Set up,js,css?,enable?,overwrite?}; put {name,file=app.js|app.css|plugin.json,content}; show {name}; enable {name}; disable {name}. js must call clanker.registerView and must not use innerHTML/eval. After create, tell the operator to Refresh Web UI plugins or reload.
